targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
			vacuumalarm__value AS vacuumalarm
FROM marpower__380000_seawater
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('vacuumalarm') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS vacuumalarm_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/380000-seawater';

elements.name: SEA WATER COOL PMP1 remote label
SEA WATER COOL PMP1 running label
SEA WATER COOL PMP2 remote label
SEA WATER COOL PMP2 running label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
			cool_pmp_1_remote__value AS pmp1_remote,
			cool_pmp_1_running__value AS pmp1_running,
			cool_pmp_2_remote__value AS pmp2_remote,
			cool_pmp_2_running__value AS pmp2_running
FROM marpower__380000_seawater
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('cool_pmp1_remote') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS pmp1_remote_tag,
			MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('cool_pmp1_running') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS pmp1_running_tag,
			MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('cool_pmp2_remote') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS pmp2_remote_tag,
			MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('cool_pmp2_running') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS pmp2_running_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/380000-seawater';

SELECT timestamp as time,
			vacuumalarm__value AS vacuum_alarm,
			cool_pmp_1_remote__value AS cooling_pump_1_remavail,
			cool_pmp_1_running__value AS cooling_pump_1_running,
			cool_pmp_2_remote__value AS cooling_pump_2_remavail,
			cool_pmp_2_running__value AS cooling_pump_2_running,
			cool_pmp_1_startstop__value AS cooling_pump_1_onoff,
			cool_pmp_2_startstop__value AS cooling_pump_2_onoff
FROM marpower__380000_seawater
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC;

SELECT timestamp as time,
			flow__value AS flow
FROM marpower__380000_seawater
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic) topic,
	alarm__value                 AS alarm,
	close__value                 AS close,
	closed__value                AS closed,
	hmi_cmd_close__value         AS hmi_cmd_close,
	hmi_cmd_open__value          AS hmi_cmd_open,
	hmi_control_available__value AS hmi_control_available,
	open__value                  AS open,
	opened__value                AS opened,
	should_be_open__value        AS should_be_open,
	power_detected__value        AS power_detected,
	multi_state_alarm__value     AS multi_state_alarm
FROM marpower__380000_seawater_cooling
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY topic, timestamp DESC;
